Map Update Function
Map data can be updated by two methods, "full update", which updates all nationwide map data, and "differential update (map on demand)", which partially updates map data using communication or media (CD-R/DVD-R), improving convenience.
Differential distribution (Map on Demand) distributes changed road data from the G-BOOK center so that the navigation map data can be updated to the latest information.
Bluetooth compatible mobile phone.
